class.name: ConsoleManager
class.brief_description: Console commands and console variables. Engine singleton.
class.description: Every script reaches it as [code]ConsoleManager[/code]. A console line is [code]name arg arg ...[/code]: arguments are separated by spaces, [code]"quoted text"[/code] is one argument and [code];[/code] separates commands. Names are case-insensitive. A line resolves, in order, to: - a registered command ([method register_command]) - its [Callable] is called with the arguments converted to the method's declared parameter types: [int], [float], [bool] ([code]1/0/true/false/on/off[/code]), [String], [Vector3] as [code]x,y,z[/code], a [Resource] by its [code]res://[/code] path, a [GameplayTag] by name. Extra words go into a trailing [String] parameter; - a console variable ([method register_variable]) - [code]name[/code] prints it, [code]name value[/code] sets it; - a method of the player's [CheatManager] - always run on the server. [constant FLAG_SERVER] commands typed on a client travel to the server through the player's [DebugReplicator] and run there as that player ([method get_executor]); whatever they print comes back to that client's console. [constant FLAG_CHEAT] commands run only while [method are_cheats_allowed]. Built-in commands: [code]dumpcommands[/code], [code]echo[/code], [code]exec[/code], [code]slomo[/code], [code]quit[/code], [code]clear[/code] (the [GameConsole]), [code]gd.toggle[/code], [code]gd.category[/code], [code]gd.target[/code], [code]gd.lock[/code], [code]gd.freecam[/code] (the [GameplayDebuggerHUD]); variables [code]cheats[/code] and [code]console.engine_log[/code] (the [GameConsole]). Give every command a help text: the console shows it, with the arguments, next to each suggestion as you type. [code]user://autoexec.cfg[/code] runs at startup when it exists. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: ConsoleManager.register_command("give_wood", func(amount: int = 10) -> void: wood += amount, "Adds wood.") ConsoleManager.register_variable("show_fps", false, "Shows the FPS counter.", ConsoleManager.FLAG_SAVED) [/codeblock]

method.name: are_cheats_allowed
method.description: Always [code]true[/code] in a debug build; otherwise the value of the [code]cheats[/code] variable (checked where the cheat runs - on the server).

method.name: describe
method.description: A one-line usage and help text for a name ([code]name

method.name: execute
method.description: Runs a line as if it was typed into this machine's console. Returns [code]false[/code] if any part of it failed. A line forwarded to the server counts as a success once it is sent.

method.name: execute_file
method.description: Runs every line of a file. Lines starting with [code]#[/code] or [code]//[/code] are comments.

method.name: get_all_names
method.description: Every command, variable and cheat name, sorted.

method.name: get_completions
method.description: Command, variable and cheat names starting with [param prefix], then the ones merely containing it.

method.name: get_executor
method.description: The [PlayerController] the running command acts for: the sender while the server runs a forwarded line, else this machine's player. May be [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_info
method.description: A name's parts, as the console's suggestions show them: [code]name[/code], [code]kind[/code] ([code]"command"[/code], [code]"variable"[/code] or [code]"cheat"[/code]), [code]usage[/code] (the arguments, read off the method), [code]help[/code], [code]tags[/code] ([code]"cheat"[/code], [code]"server"[/code]) and, for a variable, [code]value[/code]. Empty for an unknown name.

method.name: get_variable
method.description: The variable's current value, or [param default_value] when there is no such variable.

method.name: has_command
method.description: [code]true[/code] if a command of that name is registered.

method.name: has_variable
method.description: [code]true[/code] if a variable of that name is registered.

method.name: is_console_open
method.description: [code]true[/code] while the [GameConsole] overlay is open. The other debug overlays ignore their keys then.

method.name: print_error
method.description: [method print_line] as an error.

method.name: print_line
method.description: Prints to the console. While the server runs a line a client sent, the text goes back to that client's console.

method.name: print_warning
method.description: [method print_line] as a warning.

method.name: register_command
method.description: Adds a command. [param callable] gets the line's arguments converted to its parameter types (see the class description), or one [PackedStringArray] with [constant FLAG_RAW_ARGS]. A non-null return value is printed. Registering a name again replaces the command.

method.name: register_variable
method.description: Adds a console variable and returns the value now in effect - the saved one for a [constant FLAG_SAVED] variable that has one, else [param default_value]. Values set later are converted to the type of [param default_value]. Registering again keeps the current value.

method.name: set_command_usage
method.description: The arguments shown after a command's name, e.g. [code]" [lb]count[lb]"[/code] - for a [constant FLAG_RAW_ARGS] command, whose parameters cannot be read off the method.

method.name: set_variable
method.description: Sets a variable (converted to its type), saves it when it is [constant FLAG_SAVED] and emits [signal variable_changed].

method.name: unregister_command
method.description: Removes a command.

method.name: unregister_variable
method.description: Removes a console variable.

signal.name: output_printed
signal.description: Emitted for every line of console output. The [GameConsole] shows these; with nothing connected, output goes to stdout.

signal.name: variable_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a console variable changes.

constants.constant: Runs on the server; a client forwards the line.
Commands: the [Callable] gets one [PackedStringArray] with the raw words.
